digest.en: The proposed US-China trade board dominates headlines. Civilian deaths from armed drones in Sudan and the urgent need for Strait of Hormuz de-escalation also command attention. These events highlight ongoing geopolitical tensions and humanitarian crises.
digest.hi: पश्चिम बंगाल में सीएम शुभेंदु अधिकारी के पहले दिन के फैसले और असम में हिमंत बिस्वा सरमा की दूसरी बार कमान संभालना प्रमुखता से छाया रहा। वहीं, लेबनान में युद्धविराम के बावजूद जारी हमले और ईरान द्वारा अमेरिका व इस्राइल को जिम्मेदार ठहराना मध्य पूर्व की स्थिति को जटिल बना रहा है।

articles.summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are set to As trade disputes loom over this week’s meeting between US President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping, proposals for a “Board of Trade” and a separate “Board of Investment” may be on the table.

articles.summary: PFAS levels in northern gannet eggs in Canada' Levels of Pfas in northern gannet eggs in Canada fell up to 74% over 55-year period of studyLevels of some of the most dangerous Pfas compounds have dramatically fallen in Canadian seabird eggs, which the authors of a new peer-reviewed study say illustrates how regulations are effective. Researchers looked at Pfas levels in the eggs of northern gannets in the St Lawrence Seaway basin over a 55-year.

articles.title: Storm, displacement and hidden wartime explosives deepen emergency in Solomon Islands
articles.summary: Tropical Cyclone Lisa has affected over 150,000 people in the Solomon Islands. The storm has created significant humanitarian needs across the nation. Unexploded ordnance from World War II poses an additional threat to displaced populations. More than 150,000 people have been affected by Tropical Cyclone Maila, the latest storm in the Pacific area, which continues to drive what the UN relief coordination office OCHA has described as “significant humanitarian needs” across the Solomon Islands.

articles.title: Armed drones leading cause of civilian death in Sudan war: UN rights chief
articles.summary: Armed drones caused over 80 percent of civilian deaths in Sudan during the Drones caused more than 80 per cent of civilian deaths in Sudan’s war during the first four months of 2026, killing at least 880 people, the UN human rights chief said on Monday, warning that escalating drone warfare could push the conflict into an even deadlier phase.

articles.title: Strait of Hormuz de-escalation is urgent, says UN chief
articles.summary: The UN Secretary-General called for urgent de-escalation in the Strait As the Strait of Hormuz crisis deepens and tensions between Iran and the United States remain unresolved, oil prices rose again early Monday, prompting the UN Secretary-General to call for a peaceful resolution and warn of the widening fallout across Africa and beyond.

articles.title: US and Mexico brace for heatwave as deadly floods hit South Africa
articles.summary: A heatwave is expected to intensify across the western United States and Mexico this Temperatures soar in California and Arizona, while deluge continues across Western and Northern CapeHeat is expected to intensify across western parts of the US and Mexico this week as a ridge of high pressure pushes temperatures well above the seasonal norm.

articles.title: Tehran, Taiwan, trade … what are the hazards facing Trump on Xi summit tightrope?
articles.summary: Donald Trump will arrive in Beijing on Wednesday for a summit with Chinese US leader enters talks with superpower rival from vulnerable position, but will be hoping for economic wins amid turbulent backdropIf all goes to plan over the next few days – and that is a big if – Donald Trump will arrive in Beijing on Wednesday for a highly anticipated summit with Xi Jinping, China’s leader. The trip will mark the first time a US president has visited China in nearly a decade.

articles.title: Indonesian rescuers retrieve body from Mount Dukono as search continues
articles.summary: Indonesian rescuers recovered the body of a woman after a volcanic eruption on Mount Woman recovered after volcanic eruption on remote island, while operation to find two missing Singaporeans goes onRescuers have recovered the body of an Indonesian woman who was caught in a volcanic eruption on Mount Dukono on Indonesia’s remote island of Halmahera, officials have said. Search operations continued on Saturday for the bodies of two Singaporeans.

articles.title: ‘Watching us is like watching a cousin’: the online creators reshaping Africa’s news ecosphere
articles.summary: Amahle-Imvelo Jaxa posted a TikTok video explaining a dispute between the South African and Rwandan presidents. She detailed the roles of various South African groups in a conflict. Jaxa's content focuses on current affairs for a South African audience. Africa is leading a change in news consumption habits – and transforming the lives of current affairs enthusiastsLast year Amahle-Imvelo Jaxa posted a TikTok video about South African peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

articles.title: Guardian reporter and colleagues detained and beaten by Somali police
articles.summary: Guardian reporter Mohamed Bulbul was detained and beaten by Somali police in Mogadishu. He was arrested with two colleagues, Abdihafid Nor Barre and Abdishakur Mohamed Moh. The arrests followed Bulbul's reporting for the Guardian on the alleged torture of a woman in prison.

articles.title: Central African Republic: Funding cuts put humanitarian support at risk
articles.summary: Funding cuts threaten humanitarian operations in the Central African Republic. The Central African Republic (CAR) is making progress towards stability and security but major aid budget cuts threaten humanitarian operations there, a senior official with the UN aid coordination office OCHA said on Friday in New York.

articles.title: Three hikers dead after Indonesia’s Mount Dukono volcano erupts
articles.summary: Three hikers, two Singaporean and one Indonesian, died on Halmahera island after Mount Dukono erupted. They were in a restricted area when the volcano ejected an ash cloud approximately 10 kilometers high. No nearby villages were affected by the eruption.

articles.title: कुश्ती महासंघ से तकरार के बीच गोंडा पहुँचीं विनेश फोगाट, बोलीं - 'वे चाहते हैं कि मैं संन्यास ले
articles.summary: पहलवान विनेश फोगाट ने भारतीय कुश्ती महासंघ पर उन्हें संन्यास लेने के लिए मजबूर करने का आरोप लगाया है। उन्होंने कहा कि वह हार नहीं मानेंगी और विरोधियों के मंसूबों को सफल नहीं होने देंगी। विनेश फोगाट ने आरोप लगाया कि भारतीय कुश्ती महासंघ (डब्ल्यूएफआई) में सत्ता में बैठे लोग चाहते थे कि वह कुश्ती छोड़ दें, लेकिन उन्होंने कहा कि वह हार नहीं मानेंगी और उनके मंसूबों को कामयाब नहीं होने देंगी.

articles.title: ईरान-अमेरिका में शांति समझौते पर नहीं बनी बात तो होर्मुज को लेकर UN टास्क फोर्स ने दी चेतावनी
articles.summary: संयुक्त राष्ट्र की एक टास्क फोर्स ने होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य में नौवहन की स्वतंत्रता बनाए रखने के लिए एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय तंत्र का प्रस्ताव दिया है। यह प्रस्ताव ईरान और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के बीच तनाव के बीच आया है। ईरान ने कहा है कि वह जलडमरूमध्य में किसी भी सैन्य हस्तक्षेप का जवाब देगा। टास्क फोर्स ने दोनों देशों से संयम बरतने का आग्रह किया है।
